Fill color is always 1; background and marker colors vary. Core rule: for each intended multirow marker-pattern group, identify its rightmost marker extent. Color the trailing background suffix to the right edge only on rows with a horizontal marker run reaching that group’s rightmost extent; preserve marker pixels and all other cells. Do NOT treat every isolated 8-connected island inside a dense patterned band as its own fill target: that causes large overfills. Likewise, a lone marker at the maximum column in a row is not enough if it does not form the horizontal marker run (confirmed current test: lower 4x22 pattern has max marker col20; rows21 and23 have horizontal 4-runs ending at c20, so only their c21 cells become 1; rows22 and24 have isolated c20 markers and remain unchanged. Upper band ends at c21, so has no trailing suffix). This exact output solved the current test on the third submission after (wrong) attempts that independently filled 8-connected islands and then filled c21 on all four lower rows.

Confirmed demos: (1) bg2/fg0, row0 run c0-2 and trailing suffix c3-8 -> 1; full marker rows with no trailing space unchanged. (2) bg0/fg6, upper group max c9 reached by row1 -> fill c10-14 only; lower group max c12 reached by row8 -> fill c13-14. (3) bg5/fg2, row0’s rightmost horizontal run c7-8 ends at c8 -> c9-10 become 1; the later group had marker at far edge and stayed unchanged. (4) bg0/fg2, top group has rightmost marker c17 in rows0-2 -> c18-19 become 1 in all three; lower group reaches edge c19 and stays unchanged. (5) bg4/fg9, upper group reaches edge c17 and stays unchanged; lower group has rightmost c12, rows15 and17 horizontal runs to c12 and fill c13-17. In that demo row16 also had c13,c15,c17 changed to 1 while even c14,c16 remained bg; preserve as observed, not fully explained by the simple rule. Another earlier demo with bg4/fg9 changed only row0 c28 (between a final 9 marker at c27 and 4 at c29); indicates avoid assuming all pattern objects have simple one-color backgrounds.

Past failure: my first attempt used 8-connected components and filled suffixes after each island, causing overfill. My second attempt colored c21 on all four rows of the lower band; only rows with a horizontal run to the group max were eligible. Prefer grouping the visually coherent multirow pattern and applying the rightmost-horizontal-run criterion; preserve all unrelated pixels.

(6) New confirmed test (task-b4235fd4; bg9/fg8; 29x11): top group rows0-2 has row0 singleton marker at c2 and rows1-2 markers c0-1; correct output colors row0 c3-10 with 1, leaving the other rows unchanged. Lower group rows12-14 has a full horizontal marker row c2-10 reaching the right edge, so no suffix is added. Thus a singleton can qualify when it is the leading/rightmost row of this multirow pattern group (do not apply the isolated-marker exclusion without considering its role in the group).
